pages.text: Log, the Bulk, fifth crossing. It is not uniform. There are regions: the open $(thing)Bulk$(), the crystal $(thing)Graviton Reefs$() and the $(thing)Moduli Wastes$().

$(thing)Derelict Stations$() hold salvage and supplies - someone came here before me. $(thing)Collapsed Calabi-Yau Knots$() hang over the Wastes with caches at their hearts. In string theory, Calabi-Yau shapes are the tiny curled-up extra dimensions; these have come uncurled.

The locals:$(li)$(thing)Graviton Wisps$() pull you toward them and crush you up close.$(li)$(thing)Brane Striders$() slip between branes when hurt and leave you seeing double.$(li)$(thing)Moduli Crawlers$() hunt in packs and climb anything.$(br2)I keep my back to a wall. It does not help with the Crawlers.
$(thing)Graviton Wisp$(). Lives in: Graviton Reef, The Bulk.$(br)Drops: Graviton Wisp Core, Graviton Crystal, Void Lattice Shard.
$(thing)Brane Strider$(). Lives in: Graviton Reef, Moduli Wastes, The Bulk.$(br)Drops: Brane Tension Fiber, Void Lattice Shard, Kaluza-Klein Shard.
$(thing)Moduli Crawler$(). Lives in: Moduli Wastes, The Bulk.$(br)Drops: Moduli Crystal, Void Lattice Shard.
